WITH vector_results AS 
(SELECT knowledge_items.id AS id, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY knowledge_items.embedding <=> $5) AS vec_rank 
FROM knowledge_items 
WHERE (knowledge_items.org_id = $6::VARCHAR OR knowledge_items.is_public = true) AND knowledge_items.deleted_at IS NULL AND knowledge_items.embedding IS NOT NULL 
 LIMIT $7::INTEGER), 
text_results AS 
(SELECT knowledge_items.id AS id, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY ts_rank(to_tsvector($8::REGCONFIG, knowledge_items.content), plainto_tsquery($9::REGCONFIG, $10::VARCHAR)) DESC) AS text_rank 
FROM knowledge_items 
WHERE (knowledge_items.org_id = $6::VARCHAR OR knowledge_items.is_public = true) AND knowledge_items.deleted_at IS NULL AND (to_tsvector($8::REGCONFIG, knowledge_items.content) @@ plainto_tsquery($9::REGCONFIG, $10::VARCHAR)) 
 LIMIT $11::INTEGER)
 SELECT count(*) AS count_1 
FROM (SELECT knowledge_items.id AS id, knowledge_items.org_id AS org_id, knowledge_items.is_public AS is_public, knowledge_items.source_agent_id AS source_agent_id, knowledge_items.run_id AS run_id, knowledge_items.content AS content, knowledge_items.content_hash AS content_hash, knowledge_items.category AS category, knowledge_items.confidence AS confidence, knowledge_items.framework AS framework, knowledge_items.language AS language, knowledge_items.version AS version, knowledge_items.tags AS tags, knowledge_items.embedding AS embedding, knowledge_items.contributed_at AS contributed_at, knowledge_items.approved_at AS approved_at, knowledge_items.deleted_at AS deleted_at, knowledge_items.quality_score AS quality_score, knowledge_items.retrieval_count AS retrieval_count, knowledge_items.helpful_count AS helpful_count, knowledge_items.not_helpful_count AS not_helpful_count, knowledge_items.valid_at AS valid_at, knowledge_items.invalid_at AS invalid_at, knowledge_items.expired_at AS expired_at, anon_2.rrf_score * ($1::FLOAT + $2::FLOAT * knowledge_items.quality_score) AS final_score 
FROM knowledge_items JOIN (SELECT anon_3.id AS id, sum($3::FLOAT / CAST(($4::INTEGER + anon_3.rank) AS NUMERIC)) AS rrf_score 
FROM (SELECT vector_results.id AS id, vector_results.vec_rank AS rank 
FROM vector_results UNION ALL SELECT text_results.id AS id, text_results.text_rank AS rank 
FROM text_results) AS anon_3 GROUP BY anon_3.id) AS anon_2 ON knowledge_items.id = anon_2.id ORDER BY final_score DESC) AS anon_1
